review.why: Diagnoses and improves the offer itself (value, bonuses, guarantee, scarcity, name, payment) rather than the copy, with a one-lever-at-a-time loop.
review.summary: Uses a value equation with four levers (dream outcome, likelihood, time delay, effort) and a six-part offer anatomy. A diagnostic loop states the current offer, scores each lever, finds the weakest part, drafts one change and projects the lift honestly, multiplying rather than adding. It lists patterns not to use and banned vocabulary, and points to eight reference files.
strengths: Fixes the offer first instead of polishing copy on a weak one
Honest lift projection: 10 to 40% from one change, multiplied not added
Clear warnings against fake scarcity, bonus inflation and acquisition discounts
cautions: Best for services, courses, coaching and high-ticket B2B, less for self-serve software
Value-equation scores are the user's own judgment
Eight reference files with formats and examples are not read here
